$comment: Release operations manifest (i32-release-operations). Single source of truth for version scheme, environment separation, monitoring hooks, and rollback hooks. Companion prose: docs/RELEASE_OPERATIONS.md; staged-rollout plan: docs/RELEASE_PLAN_V1.md. Validated by `pnpm release:check` (tools/release/check-release-manifest.mjs). This file DEFINES operations; it executes nothing. Every entry with requiresHumanAuthorization=true is an irreversible action that must not be performed without an explicit human GO decision recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.

rules.marketingVersion: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; MUST equal iOS MARKETING_VERSION, Android versionName, and APP_VERSION in apps/mobile/src/config/runtimeConfig.ts
rules.buildNumber: committed floor: MUST equal iOS CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION and Android versionCode and MUST be <= lastShippedBuildNumber. The build number that ships is assigned by fastlane (`beta`/`release` lanes: latest_testflight_build_number + 1, applied via CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION xcargs), so it is monotonically increasing across App Store Connect, never reused or reset, and never read from the committed value
rules.lastShippedBuildNumber: last build uploaded to TestFlight for marketingVersion, per docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md §1 (Build 3, 2026-09-03); update it whenever a build is uploaded
rules.gitTag: internal TestFlight builds (the only shipping state so far: builds 1 and 3 of 1.0) record the SHA in the build notes and do NOT require a tag; store-submitted and TestFlight-external builds are built only from tag v<version>-build.<build> on the audited RC SHA. No such tag exists yet because no external/store build has been made
rules.backendImages: services/api and services/media-worker images tagged with the git SHA of the release

development.mobileConfig: runtimeConfig.ts with API_BASE_URL set to null locally (explicit not-configured state; talks to no backend)

staging.database: staging DB; all migrations rehearsed here before production
staging.mobileConfig: staging values injected at build time; never committed

production.database: production DB (Supabase project ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib); forward-fix only (RELEASE_PLAN_V1 §4)
production.mobileConfig: public production values (API origin, App Store id, RevenueCat public SDK keys, OAuth client ids) are committed in runtimeConfig.ts; secrets are never committed

environments.$comment: The production origin is public, non-secret configuration committed in apps/mobile/src/config/runtimeConfig.ts (API_BASE_URL); release:check asserts it equals production.apiOrigin and that APP_STORE_ID equals appStoreId. mediaBucket is null because no storage bucket exists: video never leaves the device (docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md). Staging is not provisioned (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL); its 'tbd' is accepted until a distinct https origin is recorded.

releaseBlockingSteps.description: External claim gate is FAIL (docs/CLAIM_REVIEW.md); all external copy limited to 'still being validated' language

The default build enables the backend (apiBaseUrl set); App Store Connect privacy questionnaire, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes (11 types, pinned by apps/mobile/__tests__/wf/fix-9-privacyManifestCollectedData.test.ts) and docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md MUST be updated together before any submission that changes what is collected
Feature-flag state in built artifacts matches the RC record on every deploy
apps/mobile `npm run check:distribution` green at the release SHA

monitoringHooks.signal: silent-failure-v1.1 rate per stage (contact/stroke/ownership), grouped by user/session/source, never per-frame
monitoringHooks.alarm: any stage exceeds its frozen budget

monitoringHooks.signal: TARGET wrong-lock reports (support-sourced + C17 targetLock tap-distance telemetry)
monitoringHooks.alarm: any confirmed wrong-target with confident downstream output

monitoringHooks.signal: analysis completion rate; per-stage latency percentiles (cold vs warm); paddle-worker fallback count
monitoringHooks.alarm: nonzero worker fallback rate (warm path silently degrading)

monitoringHooks.signal: g21 session-engine event states: READY with missing content, retry-queue depth, recoverPending() outcomes after restart
consent ledger append-only violations; export v2 signature verification failures; deletion cascade completions; training-consent opt-in audit
monitoringHooks.alarm: any append-only violation or any training use without opt-in

monitoringHooks.signal: feature-flag drift check on every deploy against the RC record
monitoringHooks.alarm: any drift from the RC record

rollbackHooks.action: pause App Store phased release; a shipped binary cannot be un-shipped
expedited-review submission of the previous good build (or a build with the offending flag forced off)
analysis endpoints return typed maintenance errors (existing typed-error contract) to disable analysis without a client update; coach surfaces already gate-blocked server-side
redeploy the previous SHA-tagged image; images are stateless, config/flags roll back with the deployment
forward-fix only: remediate a bad migration with a new forward migration, never edit or revert an applied one; consent ledger (0015-0017) is append-only by design
LAST RESORT; prohibited once real consent records exist in the discarded window (consent-integrity violation); requires release owner + privacy owner with written rationale

irreversibleActions.$comment: blocked entirely until the claim gate passes; listed so tooling never treats it as authorized
